analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($2,631.18) vs SMA5/20/50($2,489.53/$2,453.07/$2,295.76): Above short/mid-term trends, confirming bullish position.
· High position relative to SMA100/200($2,005.86/$2,070.4): Mid-to-long term trend strength advantage.
· 52-week position (34.6%) + Current price range near historical median.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (58.5→65.4): Entering overbought territory, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-17.7441→-11.7648): Improving, potential for bearish convergence but weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Upper Band $2,581.13): Approaching upper band, bandwidth at 8.75% is normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,626.87): Support confirmed based on Pivot S1($2,437.23) and SMA20($2,472.95).
· Swing Resistance ($2,635.19): Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Uptrend continuation confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.49x): Recent movement is strong, increasing reliability.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Caution for short-term overheating, meeting conditions for observation due to 5 consecutive days of gains.
